name: Cherith
overview: Cherith was a brook located near Jericho, east of the Jordan River, where the prophet Elijah was instructed by the Lord to hide and receive sustenance. Scripture records that Elijah drank from this brook and was miraculously fed by ravens bringing him bread and meat morning and evening. This provision sustained him until the brook eventually dried up due to a lack of rain, illustrating God's sovereign care and timing in the prophet's life.
